trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is no shortcut: the platinum pops the moment the last of the other 54 unlocks. Use the Roadmap tab to plan the long grind, and save the quick cleanups for last.
trophies.tip: A Long Road (100% completion) is the longest single requirement — start its counters early.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks automatically as you play through the start of the story — you cannot miss it. Just follow the opening beats until the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends. Make a manual save at the end of each chapter, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.tip: Keep a separate manual save per chapter; there are 15 save slots.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. A story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends. Keep your manual saves going, one per chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends. The big bank-vault robberies for the 100% checklist open up during this chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. The last story mission of the game; finishing it unlocks free roam across Leonida, so the cleanup can start right after.
trophies.tip: Once the story is done, the 100% Completion checklist appears in Progress > Stats.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy — play through the mission when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story trophy — play through the mission when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A story trophy — play through the mission when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A story trophy — play through the mission when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A story trophy — play through the mission when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy — play through the mission when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion). You do not need everything in the game — only the checklist's numbers. See the Roadmap tab for the full breakdown: story done, 100 optional tasks, the robbery and fencing quotas, the collectible counts, and the activity medals.
trophies.tip: Check the list after the story; progress made during the story already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the short driving feats the game tracks — jumps, near-misses, drifts and the like. The 100% checklist needs 300 of 397 stunts, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.tip: Chain stunts during normal driving instead of grinding them in one place.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. Sample one of everything — a race, a shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, pool, mini golf, basketball, a drone trial and a stunt event — and the trophy is yours. It is a taster, not a grind.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 range challenges in total and every one needs gold. Learn each range's scoring with a practice run first, then go for gold — the medals are per challenge, so improve them one at a time.
trophies.tip: The 100% checklist also needs all 42 gold medals — same work, same progress.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations; win one race at each. Drone trials also feed the 100% checklist (42 of 42), so learn the fast lines early.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road, air and water events all qualify. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 races won, so keep racing past this one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Bring your best rod setup and watch the tension meter — steady reeling beats frantic mashing.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet and play it through to the end of a game. The shortest cabinet is the fastest route.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the Strangers & Freaks questlines — follow his missions until the last one completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission; his missions also tie into the Kenton's Treasure collectibles.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than eight strands in the state, so pick the eight you like — you do not need every stranger's full storyline.
trophies.tip: The five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus Bret's hunting strand count toward this.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 required spots across Leonida. THE one trophy you can miss: the first meditation happens with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, in the morning after the mission 'Down to Earth' in Chapter 1 — accept her invitation and meditate before you leave Chapter 1. The other 17 spots stay available in free roam; the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, but the trophy needs all 18.
trophies.tip: Make a manual save before the balcony scene, just in case.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks for specific animals — track the target he names, study it with binoculars first, then take the shot. His Target Deck (15 of 15) is also part of the 100% checklist.
trophies.tip: Study animals with binoculars whenever you meet a new species — 100 studied species are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a finished set is all the cards of one set. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so this pops early in the card hunt.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and scan new vehicles, landmarks and points of interest as you travel — 100 distinct scans. Scan from the start of the story and it will be nearly done by the time the story ends.
trophies.tip: The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK locations — same scans, same progress.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small open-world objectives tracked in the Progress menu — 50 of 80 for this trophy, 70 of 80 for 100%. Pick the easy ones first and leave the hardest ten alone.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Fast cars and the countryside beat a shootout.
trophies.tip: Use the partner's presence — the trophy only counts with them alongside.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between robberies — plan a tight route and a fast getaway car before the first shop.
trophies.tip: Do not let the wanted level clear between shops, or the chain resets.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count when you first encounter them — drive everywhere, scan with WAiNK, and try different districts. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so keep discovering past this one.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together and chain the takedowns before the focus ends. Pick a mission or shootout with clustered enemies.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport — get on board as it prepares to leave and take off. Expect a heavy police response; a fast approach and a clean runway line help.
trophies.tip: Method reported by KeenGamer; try it during a quiet moment at the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Tanks appear at military sites and during high wanted levels — take one, then use its cannon on enemies to register the combat use.
trophies.tip: Method reported by KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quiet, and leave before the alarm trips — stealth over speed. If you are spotted, leave and try another store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big jobs — five successful vault robberies with a clean escape. The 100% checklist needs 8 of 8 vaults, so the vaults you do for this trophy count toward A Long Road too.
trophies.tip: The eight large vaults unlock with the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and get away with the cash before the police box you in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Uncover the complete map — every region and road. Drive the coastline, the swamps and the city streets; the map fills in as you go.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are nine gangs in Leonida; hit one illegal operation for each of them. Operations are marked once you find them — work through the list gang by gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still being confirmed — reports point to ordering a cocktail at a bar overlooking Ocean Beach. Try the beachfront bars in the evening and watch for the prompt; check back here when the method is pinned down.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed: do not rely on unverified methods for this one.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed — the trophy's name points to a dramatic showroom exit, likely by driving a vehicle through the glass. No verified method yet; avoid relying on unconfirmed tips.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed: check back once the community pins the trigger down.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal the three key valuables at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and escape. Plan the grab and the exit before you touch the first valuable.
trophies.tip: Method reported by KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train Strength with both characters — gym work and physical activities raise it; keep at it until both bars are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Just play the game — robberies, crimes and other profile-affecting actions add up over a full playthrough. It pops naturally well before the platinum.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This hidden trophy's unlock method is still unconfirmed. The name hints at failing something and trying again — but no verified method exists yet, so do not chase rumors.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed: no verified trigger is known yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This hidden trophy's unlock method is still unconfirmed. No verified trigger is known yet — it will be added here as soon as the community pins it down.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed: no verified trigger is known yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The method is still being confirmed — the description points to a melee-weapon drive-by that knocks down multiple targets. Try a melee drive-by from a slow-moving vehicle against a group; check back for a confirmed method.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed: precise method still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills through your laundering contacts until $250,000 is cleaned. It also counts toward the 100% checklist's $250,000 marked-bills quota — same money, same progress.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear across Leonida's shops until $100,000 is spent. Big-ticket weapons and vehicle upgrades make this quick.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are eight purchasable garages across Leonida — buy them all. Robberies and fencing will fund them; the 100% grind pays for this one.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten vehicles you like, then register each through the Scooter Bros app. Any ten count — grab them as you discover new models.
